disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license, or in connection with renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for, or procuring, a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a felony or misdemeanor, entry of an administrative sanction, or sex offender registration requirement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee's conviction of or plea of guilty or plea of nolo contendere, as set forth in subsection (e) of Section 5-25, to: (A) a felony or misdemeanor in this State or any other jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to physical illness, mental illness, or disability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of a physical illness, mental illness, or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing from a retail sales establishment without a separate, distinct office area.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice under this Act as a licensee in a retail sales establishment from an office, desk, or space that is not separated from the main retail business and located within a separate and distinct area within the establishment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined by another state or jurisdiction for the same or equivalent ground.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined by another state, the District of Columbia, a territory, a foreign nation, or a governmental agency authorized to impose discipline if at least one of the grounds for that discipline is the same as or the equivalent of one of the grounds for which a licensee may be disciplined under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in real estate brokerage without a license or while expired, inactive, revoked, or suspended.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of real estate brokerage without a license or after the licensee's license or temporary permit was expired or while the license was inactive, revoked, or suspended.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the Real Estate License Exam or a continuing education course or examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the Real Estate License Exam or a continuing education course or examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an applicant to subvert or cheat on the Real Estate License Exam or continuing education exam.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an applicant to subvert or cheat on the Real Estate License Exam or continuing education exam administered pursuant to this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is inaccurate, misleading, or contrary to the provisions of the Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is inaccurate, misleading, or contrary to the provisions of the Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any substantial misrepresentation or untruthful advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial misrepresentation or untruthful advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false promises likely to influence, persuade, or induce.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade, or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through licensees, employees, agents, advertising, or otherwise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or the making of false promises through licensees, employees, agents, advertising, or otherwise.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any trade name or insignia of membership in a real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any misleading or untruthful advertising, or using any trade name or insignia of membership in any real estate organization of which the licensee is not a member.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without providing written notice to all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without providing written notice to all parties for whom the licensee acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or performing licensed activities for a broker other than the sponsoring broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or attempting to represent, or performing licensed activities for, a broker other than the sponsoring broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit any moneys or documents belonging to others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to account for or to remit any moneys or documents coming into the licensee's possession that belong to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain and deposit escrow moneys in a separate account or to maintain them on deposit until transactions are consummated or terminated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain and deposit in a special account, separate and apart from personal and other business accounts, all escrow moneys belonging to others entrusted to a licensee while acting as a broker, escrow agent, or temporary custodian of the funds of others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make available to the Department all escrow records and related documents within 24 hours of a request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make available to the Department all escrow records and related documents maintained in connection with the practice of real estate within 24 hours of a request for those documents by Department personnel.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish copies upon request of documents relating to a real estate transaction to a party who executed that document.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish copies upon request of documents relating to a real estate transaction to a party who has executed that document.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a sponsoring broker or licensee to timely provide sponsorship or termination of sponsorship information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a sponsoring broker or licensee to timely provide sponsorship or termination of sponsorship information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling the money or property of others with the licensee's own money or property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or property of others with the licensee's own money or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing persons on a temporary or single-deal basis to evade licensing requirements for commission payments.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing any person on a purely temporary or single deal basis as a means of evading the law regarding payment of commission to nonlicensees on some contemplated transactions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of one's broker license to enable a residential leasing agent or unlicensed person to operate a real estate business without actual participation or control by the broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting the use of one's license as a broker to enable a residential leasing agent or unlicensed person to operate a real estate business without actual participation therein and control thereof by the broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have a written brokerage agreement between the sponsoring broker and a client for whom the designated agent is working.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have a written brokerage agreement between the sponsoring broker and a client for whom the designated agent is working.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Displaying a 'for rent' or 'for sale' sign without the written consent of the owner or authorized agent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displaying a "for rent" or "for sale" sign on any property without the written consent of an owner or the owner's duly authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information requested by the Department, or otherwise respond, within 30 days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide information requested by the Department, or otherwise respond to that request, within 30 days of the request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by means of a blind advertisement except as otherwise permitted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising by means of a blind advertisement, except as otherwise permitted in Section 10-30 of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Influencing prospective real estate parties to promote racially or religiously segregated housing or discourage integrated housing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Influencing or attempting to influence, by any words or acts, a prospective seller, purchaser, occupant, landlord, or tenant of real estate, in connection with viewing, buying, or leasing real estate, so as to promote or tend to promote the continuance or maintenance of racially and religiously segregated housing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that constitutes a violation of Article 3 of the Illinois Human Rights Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that constitutes a violation of any provision of Article 3 of the Illinois Human Rights Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing any party to break a contract of sale, lease, or brokerage agreement for the purpose of substituting a new contract with a third party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inducing any party to a contract of sale or lease or brokerage agreement to break the contract of sale or lease or brokerage agreement for the purpose of substituting, in lieu thereof, a new contract for sale or lease or brokerage agreement with a third party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negotiating directly with a person the licensee knows has an exclusive brokerage agreement with another broker without authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negotiating a sale, exchange, or lease of real estate directly with any person if the licensee knows that the person has an exclusive brokerage agreement with another broker, unless specifically authorized by that broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: When also an attorney, acting as the attorney for buyer or seller in the same transaction in which the licensee also acts as broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When a licensee is also an attorney, acting as the attorney for either the buyer or the seller in the same transaction in which the licensee is acting or has acted as a managing broker or broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising merchandise or services as free without disclosing required conditions or obligations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or offering merchandise or services as free if any conditions or obligations necessary for receiving the merchandise or services are not disclosed in the same advertisement or offer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of any order issued by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the terms of any order issued by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or failing to disclose compensation in violation of Article 10 of this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or failing to disclose compensation in violation of Article 10 of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring a non-client party to allow the licensee to retain escrow moneys for commission as a condition for release.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requiring a party to a transaction who is not a client of the licensee to allow the licensee to retain a portion of the escrow moneys for payment of the licensee's commission or expenses as a condition for release of the escrow moneys to that party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating any provision of this Act or published rules, or aiding any person in doing so.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disregarding or violating any provision of this Act or the published rules adopted by the Department to enforce this Act or aiding or abetting any individual, foreign or domestic partnership, registered limited liability partnership, limited liability company, corporation, or other business entity in disregarding any provision of this Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide minimum services required under an exclusive brokerage agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide the minimum services required by Section 15-75 of this Act when acting under an exclusive brokerage agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, or other chemical agents resulting in inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use of or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug that results in a licensee's inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Enabling, aiding, or abetting an auctioneer to conduct a real estate auction in violation of this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Enabling, aiding, or abetting an auctioneer, as defined in the Auction License Act, to conduct a real estate auction in a manner that is in violation of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a residential leasing agent or temporary permit holder to engage in activities requiring a broker's or managing broker's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting any residential leasing agent or temporary residential leasing agent permit holder to engage in activities that require a broker's or managing broker's license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the Department within 30 days of a qualifying conviction or administrative sanction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the Department, within 30 days after the occurrence, of the information required in subsection (e) of Section 5-25.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A designated managing broker's failure to provide a written company policy or perform required supervisory duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A designated managing broker's failure to provide an appropriate written company policy or failure to perform any of the duties set forth in Section 10-55.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing liens or recording instruments on noncommercial residential real property relating to a broker's compensation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Filing liens or recording written instruments in any county in the State on noncommercial, residential real property that relate to a broker's compensation for licensed activity under the Act.

definition_quote.value: "Broker" means an individual, entity, corporation, foreign or domestic partnership, limited liability company, registered limited liability partnership, or other business entity other than a residential leasing agent who, whether in person or through any media or technology, for another and for compensation, or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation, either directly or indirectly: (1) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, or leases real estate. (2) Offers to sell, exchange, purchase, rent, or lease real estate. (3) Negotiates, offers, attempts, or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of real estate. (4) Lists, offers, attempts, or agrees to list real estate for sale, rent, lease, or exchange.
definition_quote.quote: "Broker" means an individual, entity, corporation, foreign or domestic partnership, limited liability company, registered limited liability partnership, or other business entity other than a residential leasing agent who, whether in person or through any media or technology, for another and for compensation, or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation, either directly or indirectly:

value: Selling, exchanging, purchasing, renting, or leasing real estate
Negotiating real estate transactions

Assisting in negotiating transactions

Selling or leasing real estate at auction
Preparing or providing a broker price opinion or comparative market analysis
methods_authorized.quote: Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, or leases real estate... Negotiates, offers, attempts, or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of real estate... Lists, offers, attempts, or agrees to list real estate for sale, rent, lease, or exchange... Supervises the collection, offer, attempt, or agreement to collect rent for the use of real estate... Prepares or provides a broker price opinion or comparative market analysis

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Provide satisfactory evidence of having completed 75 hours of instruction in real estate courses approved by the Department, 15 hours of which must consist of situational and case studies presented in the classroom or by live, interactive webinar or online distance education courses;

value: situational and case studies (15 hours, classroom or live interactive webinar or online)
required_instruction_topics.quote: 15 hours of which must consist of situational and case studies presented in the classroom or by live, interactive webinar or online distance education courses

exam_application_window_years.quote: If a person who has received a passing score on the written examination described in this Section fails to submit an application and meet all requirements for a license under this Act within one year after receiving a passing score on the examination, credit for the examination shall terminate.

agency_relationship_types.quote: "Agency" means a relationship in which a broker or licensee, whether directly or through an affiliated licensee, represents a consumer by the consumer's consent, whether express or implied, in a real property transaction.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: An individual licensee may act as a dual agent or a sponsoring broker may permit one or more of its sponsored licensees to act as dual agents in the same transaction only with the informed written consent of all clients.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: "Designated agency" means a contractual relationship between a sponsoring broker and a client under Section 15-50 of this Act in which one or more licensees associated with or employed by the broker are designated as agent of the client.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A licensee acting as a designated agent shall advise a consumer in writing, no later than beginning to work as a designated agent on behalf of the consumer

written_service_agreement_required.quote: All brokerage agreements shall be in writing

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: No licensee shall obtain any written brokerage agreement that does not either provide for automatic expiration within a definite period of time

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Any record relating to a transaction of a special account shall be maintained for a minimum of 5 years

escrow_account_required.quote: Failure to maintain and deposit in a special account, separate and apart from personal and other business accounts, all escrow moneys belonging to others entrusted to a licensee while acting as a broker, escrow agent, or temporary custodian of the funds of others

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Commingling the money or property of others with the licensee's own money or property.

fixed_office_required.quote: each sponsoring broker shall maintain an office, or place of business within this State for the transaction of real estate business

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: The sponsoring broker shall name a designated managing broker for each office and the sponsoring broker shall be responsible for supervising all designated managing brokers.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No applicant shall engage in any of the activities covered by this Act without a valid license and until a valid sponsorship has been registered with the Department.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: a sponsoring broker may pay compensation directly to a business entity solely owned by that licensee that has been formed for the purpose of receiving compensation earned by the licensee.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: When any aggrieved person recovers a valid judgment in any court of competent jurisdiction in an action in which the court has found the aggrieved person to be injured or otherwise damaged by any licensee or an unlicensed employee of any licensee as a result of fraud, misrepresentation, discrimination, or deceit or intentional violation of this Act by the licensee or the unlicensed employee of the licensee, the aggrieved person may, upon the termination of all proceedings, including review and appeals in connection with the judgment, file a verified claim in the court in which the judgment was entered and, upon 30 days' written notice to the Department, and to the person against whom the judgment was obtained, may apply to the court for a post-judgment order directing payment from the Real Estate Recovery Fund

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A broker price opinion or comparative market analysis may be prepared or provided by a real estate broker or managing broker

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: A broker price opinion or comparative market analysis may be prepared or provided by a real estate broker or managing broker
